reason: Credit support under the AI-cloud revenue-sharing programme is one programme within q09's total of financing commitments and capacity backstops, and both are read in the same FY2027 annual report, so a part of the reference total does not separate them.

Customer lease guarantees and capacity-purchase commitments outstanding at the FY2027 annual report are q09's financing commitments and capacity backstops to customers, settled by the same FY2027 year-end figure.
Both ask whether NVIDIA signs a guarantee of OpenAI's Ohio data-center lease; only the deadline differs (2027-12-31 vs 2027-06-30), which does not separate the same event.
The Vera Rubin platform is the Rubin generation, and both ask whether it begins shipping by December 31, 2026.
The wording is identical to q04: calendar-2026 data-center capital expenditures of the four largest AI hyperscalers.
Both ask for the combined calendar-2027 data-center capital expenditures of the largest (four) AI hyperscalers, settled by the same reported totals.
Supply commitments are NVIDIA's purchase obligations to its suppliers, a different reported figure from q09's financing commitments and capacity backstops to customers and partners.
Shipping the Kyber NVL144 rack is the same event as shipping Rubin Ultra in Kyber NVL144 racks; only the deadline differs (2028 vs 2027), which does not separate them.
Both ask whether Chinese authorities authorize H200 imports; the named companies are a part of q08's any-Chinese-company scope and the earlier deadline is another deadline for the same event.
Completing a roughly $500 million purchase of Firmus preference shares is a single equity investment that no reference question asks about.
Both ask for NVIDIA's total revenue for FY2027, settled by the same reported figure.
An unqualified FY2027 gross margin is the reported GAAP line, a different figure from q03's non-GAAP gross margin that can fall in another band.
The conclusion of a French antitrust investigation into Nvidia is not asked by any reference question.
